20 Firms Bid for India's Rare Earth Magnet Manufacturing Scheme

Twenty companies have submitted bids for India's scheme to manufacture rare earth magnets. Among the bidders are Larsen & Toubro (L&T) and Coal India Limited (CIL). The scheme aims to boost domestic production of these critical materials. This initiative is part of India's broader strategy to achieve self-reliance in strategic sectors.
